scoring_justification: Checker recomputes CEF eigenvalues from the cubic Hamiltonian and C55(T) from the full model, then compares agent's reported values with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold CEF level energies in Kelvin from paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: singlet at 0 K, triplet at 203 K, doublet at 347 K, triplet at 781 K
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are explicitly reported in the paper as the derived level scheme from the fitted B4 parameter.

outputs.description: CEF energy levels (nine entries) with energies in Kelvin, degeneracy, and irrep label. The checker recomputes the eigenvalues from the same Hamiltonian and compares within tolerance.
Modeled C55(T) at specified temperatures (50,100,150,200,250,300 K). The checker recomputes C55 using the same model and parameters and compares within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Parameters are as reported in the paper: B4 = −20.8×10⁻³ meV, η3 = 21 meV, N = 1.227×10²⁸ m⁻³, C0 = 73.9 GPa, s = 18.3 GPa, TE = 783 K. The agent must compute the results from these parameters; no experimental data fitting is required.

steps.description: Compare CEF level energies and irreps to recomputed values from the cubic Hamiltonian.
Recompute C55(T) from model and compare to agent's values at the specified temperatures.
